saints.name: The Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed
saints.title: All Souls' Day
saints.shortBlurb: The day the Church prays for all the faithful departed still being purified before they enter the joy of heaven…
biography: On All Souls' Day the Church remembers in prayer, sacrifice, and almsgiving all the faithful departed — the souls in purgatory who have died in God's grace but are not yet fully purified. It expresses the ancient Christian conviction that the living may aid the dead by their intercession, above all through the offering of the Mass.

The general commemoration was established for the monasteries of Cluny by their abbot St. Odilo near the end of the tenth century, fixed on the day after All Saints, and was gradually adopted by the whole Western Church. Priests are permitted to offer three Masses on this day for the departed.
saints.knownFor: Prayer and sacrifice offered for the souls in purgatory.
